Diabetic Carrot French Fries
By: lisa lore
Published: Monday, April 22, 2013 - 5:57am

Ingredients




◦5 large carrots
◦2 tablespoons olive oil
◦½ teaspoon celtic sea salt

Preparation

1 1.Cut each carrot into 2-inch long sections 2 2.Cut each section into thin sticks 3 3.In a large bowl toss carrot sticks with olive oil and salt 4 4.Spread out carrot sticks on a parchment paper baking sheet 5 5.Bake at 450° for 20 minutes until carrots are browned

About

I came across  this Diabetic Carrot French Fries recipe on the internet the other day and gave it a try.
